title: Executive summary view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's executive-summary view: the leadership roll-up of the scope as of the findings rollup's as_of. It is composed from the component view contracts by reference, never by copying their shapes: the findings rollup, and when the filter asks for them the ATT&CK, PQC, isolation (threat register) and IaC (census layer) panels; fleet-wide, the top advisory rows of dependency exposure. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present, nullable ones included; lists are never null. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

rollup.description: The scope's findings rollup: the findings-rollup view's contract.

credential_leaks.description: Open credential and secret findings, most severe first (unrated last), then by repository URL and title.

themes.description: Open findings by risk theme, most first, then by theme.

hardening_themes.description: Hardening findings by risk theme, most first, then by theme.

languages.description: Open findings of the repositories whose primary language this is, most open first, then by language.

exposure.description: Fleet-wide only: the top 10 advisory rows of the exposure view (most commits first), each the exposure contract's row keyed by an advisory id. Null for a product or team scope.

attack.description: The ATT&CK panel, when the filter asks for it: the attack-coverage view's contract. Null otherwise.

pqc.description: The PQC panel, when the filter asks for it and names no as_of: the pqc-portfolio view's contract. Null otherwise.

pqc_unavailable.description: Why the PQC panel is empty when it was asked for at an as_of (Core reads current readiness only and never substitutes it); null otherwise.

isolation.description: The isolation panel, when the filter asks for it; null otherwise.

iac.description: The declared-IaC panel, when the filter asks for it; null otherwise.

allOf.$comment: The PQC panel is either built or explained, never both.
The exposure panel is the exposure view's advisory cut, keyed by advisory id.

theme_counts.description: Risk theme (raw label) to the findings carrying it; only themes seen appear.

credential_leak.description: An open credential or secret finding. The rollup's top findings are critical or high only; a leak can be any severity, or unrated.

title.description: Raw untrusted finding title, preserved as data rather than authored Markdown or HTML.

severity.description: The severity registry's effective severity; null when unrated.

sla_due.description: When the finding's SLA falls due; null when no SLA deadline applies.

language.description: The primary language, raw; unknown when none was measured.

privileges.description: Declared-privilege posture from the latest priv-profiles: posture, never finding counts.

privileged.description: Of those, the ones declaring privileged workloads.

scc_requesting.description: Of those, the ones requesting a security context constraint.

wildcard_repositories.description: Of those, the ones with a wildcard RBAC rule.

flags.description: Privilege flag (raw) to the profiles' count of it, most first; only flags seen appear.

reviews.description: Each repository's latest completed default-line isolation review, worst posture first, then most gaps, then by service and repository.

threat_register.description: The scope's threat register: the threat-register view's contract.

dimensions.description: Isolation check result (as the review states it) to how many interface dimensions have it; only results seen appear.

targets.description: One row per audit, most unsuppressed findings first, then by repository.

ledgered.description: Reported findings with a recorded disposition.
